nameboards_per_modeled_station.exterior_orientation: One outward-facing end board at each longitudinal end, hung below the continuous viaduct soffit and offset toward a road-clear kerb; no roadside posts.
nameboards_per_modeled_station.interior_orientation: One inward-facing railing board per platform, normal perpendicular to travel, above waiting heads at train-window height.

implementation.train_side_displays: Every visible coach has a directed origin → destination panel on each side; long text scrolls and pooled trains rebind their current service.
implementation.passenger_activity: Stationary seated/standing waiting figures; actual stopped-train dwell snapshots drive outward-side door opening, alighting, boarding and departure cleanup.

limitations: The source game contains 57 station anchors and one nearest-corridor platform pair per anchor. Stationary crowds and two matched real train directions are validated for all 57 modeled pairs.

Three interchange services, six directions total, are deliberately guarded because their additional physical platform pairs are not modeled: Blue at Ameerpet, Green at MG Bus Station, Blue at Parade Grounds. Their trains and directed destination displays continue operating.
The legacy source uses a shared Parade Grounds anchor for the interchange; official Green service text uses JBS Parade Ground. No new stack heights or station positions were invented.
Crowd counts, per-dwell transfer numbers and appearance diversity are heuristic. Official peak windows inform timing, not measured ridership.
Component simulations and automated geometry checks are not completed main-game driving/delivery or physical-phone readability verification.

The complete rendered-triangle station-name visibility regression covers both RTC Cross Roads approaches, not a visual tour of every station. All 57 station plate footprints are independently checked against actual road headroom envelopes.

station_structure_audit.validation: offline source road/building station neighborhoods; not citywide browser verification

rtc_exterior_visibility.regression: Both road-level approaches raycast to six caption samples per name against actual rendered production road/station/metro/support meshes, including all source pillars.
rtc_exterior_visibility.validation: Offline rendered triangle visibility test; browser observations recorded independently by the root agent.
